instruction: Find the contact us page for customer support.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the contact us page on Ticketek. Evaluator checks if the URL contains 'contact', indicating successful navigation to the customer support contact page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info() retrieves active tab URL from accessibility tree and returns {'title', 'url', 'content'}
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match() extracts URL from result (handles both string and dict format) and uses re.search() to check if 'contact' pattern appears in URL
Semantic verification is appropriate: checking for 'contact' in URL is a reasonable way to verify navigation to contact page
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (find contact page) and evaluator checks this requirement
Expected value is semantically correct: pattern 'contact' will match 'contact', 'contact-us', 'contact_us', etc., providing good robustness
Data flow is correct: active_tab_info getter -> URL extraction in metric -> pattern matching -> return 1.0 if found, 0.0 otherwise
